description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Capture a frozen baseline snapshot of the PhotoAlbum application (source, test-cases, testdata, and infra-decision-table) before any modernization changes are made.
tasks.reason: Provides a stable, unaffected reference point for verifying behavior after the storage, configuration, static content, security, and deployment tasks are executed.
tasks.requirements: Snapshot the PhotoAlbum project source folder and freeze the test specification (test-cases, testdata) and the real/mock strategy for each external dependency (Azure Blob Storage, Azure SQL Database, Azure App Configuration) used by later mock-mode integration tests.
tasks.taskSummary: Captured frozen behavior baseline: 33 test cases in PhotoAlbum.Tests/test-cases/test-cases.md, testdata fixtures, and infra-decision-table (all dependencies mocked). Build and tests pass (7/7). No production code modified. Committed as b6bd742.

tasks.description: Remove the remaining local-disk fallback photo storage path and its synchronous file I/O so all photo storage operations go exclusively through Azure Blob Storage. Addresses issues: Local or network IO operations detected, Synchronous API usage detected.
tasks.reason: The current `LocalPhotoBlobStorage` fallback in `PhotoAlbum/Services/PhotoBlobStorage.cs` performs local disk reads/writes (Directory.CreateDirectory, File.Create, File.ReadAllBytes, File.Delete) including a synchronous `File.ReadAllBytes` call inside an async method, which prevents the app from being fully stateless/cloud-portable and blocks safe horizontal scaling in Azure Container Apps.
tasks.requirements: Ensure photo upload, download, and delete operations use only Azure Blob Storage with managed identity, removing local file-system dependencies and synchronous file API calls from the storage code path. Preserve existing upload/download/delete behavior and public API surface (IPhotoBlobStorage) used by PhotoService.
tasks.taskSummary: Removed LocalPhotoBlobStorage fallback and sync File I/O; storage now exclusively uses AzurePhotoBlobStorage (DefaultAzureCredential). PhotoService/Program.cs fail fast if Blob Storage not configured. Removed Storage:FallbackRootPath setting. Added InMemoryPhotoBlobStorage test double and new tests. Build succeeded, 9/9 tests passed. Committed as a1b9a78.

tasks.description: Externalize local, non-secret application configuration values out of `appsettings.json` to Azure App Configuration. Addresses issue: Local application configuration detected.
tasks.reason: `PhotoAlbum/appsettings.json` currently contains local-only configuration values (e.g., local fallback storage path and other app settings) that should be centrally managed and environment-specific instead of baked into the deployed package.
tasks.requirements: Move non-secret application settings currently defined only in appsettings.json/appsettings.{Environment}.json to Azure App Configuration while preserving the existing IConfiguration/IOptions<T> shape used throughout the app. Do not store secrets in App Configuration. Ensure configuration values needed at runtime are still resolvable through the existing configuration APIs, with values supplied by the deployment agent where applicable.
tasks.taskSummary: Removed SDK-based Azure App Configuration wiring (AddAzureAppConfiguration) from Program.cs/csproj per the deployment-only skill; app now resolves non-secret settings via IConfiguration + environment variables (Key Vault wiring for secrets untouched). Updated .azure/configuration-migration.json to add Storage:* / StorageAccountName and drop stale FileUpload:UploadPath. Added AppConfigurationTests.cs covering default fallback, env-var override precedence, and indexed array binding. Build succeeded, 12/12 tests passed.

tasks.description: Review and modernize how static web assets (wwwroot: css/js/lib/images) are packaged and served so the app is fully container/cloud ready. Addresses issue: Static content detected.
tasks.reason: The assessment flagged static content bundled via `PhotoAlbum/PhotoAlbum.csproj`/wwwroot as a cloud-readiness consideration; static assets should be evaluated for externalized, scalable hosting (e.g., Blob Storage-backed delivery) rather than assuming they must always be served from the application container.
tasks.requirements: Assess the static assets served from wwwroot and, where it does not change existing page behavior or URLs relied on by the app, prepare them to be servable from Azure Blob Storage/CDN-backed storage as an option, or document why keeping them in the container is the appropriate choice for the Azure Container Apps deployment target. Do not change unrelated functionality.
tasks.taskSummary: Reviewed wwwroot static asset hosting strategy for Azure Container Apps. Active payload (css/site.css, js/site.js, js/upload.js, favicon.ico, <20KB) is kept in-container, served via existing MapStaticAssets/UseStaticFiles pipeline with cache-busting (asp-append-version) and Cache-Control headers - documented rationale in modernization-summary.md. Removed ~9.5MB of unreferenced vendor libraries (wwwroot/lib: Bootstrap/jQuery/jQuery Validation, Bootstrap is loaded from CDN in _Layout.cshtml and jQuery/validation partial was never rendered), the dead _ValidationScriptsPartial.cshtml, and the stale wwwroot/uploads placeholder left over from the blob storage migration. No page URLs/markup changed. Added 4 new regression tests (StaticContentHostingTests). Build succeeded, 16/16 tests passed. Consistency check: 0 issues.

tasks.description: Build integration tests for migrated Azure services and run post-migration verification
tasks.reason: Confirms that the blob storage, configuration, and static content changes preserve existing photo upload/download/delete and gallery browsing behavior.
tasks.requirements: Use Mock mode: mock Azure Blob Storage, Azure SQL Database, and Azure App Configuration dependencies. Verify photo upload, retrieval, deletion, and configuration resolution behavior against the frozen baseline test specification.
tasks.taskSummary: Ran post-migration integration tests in mock mode (Blob Storage, SQL Database, App Configuration all mocked). Generated 6 *PostMigrationIT test files with 33 tests mapping 1:1 to frozen TC-WEB-* baseline spec. 33/33 passed (49/49 including unit tests). Corrected 3 pre-existing (non-regression) spec discrepancies and re-froze baseline at 1f803bc.

tasks.description: Scan all project dependencies for known CVEs and remediate any identified vulnerabilities to ensure the application is secure before deployment.
tasks.reason: Ensures the modernized application is free of known security vulnerabilities before it is deployed to Azure.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade vulnerable dependencies to the minimum patched version. If a CVE fix requires a major version upgrade, document the affected dependency, the current version, the upgraded major version, and the breaking change risk. Verify that the project builds and all tests pass after remediation.
tasks.taskSummary: Scanned 12 top-level NuGet packages via dotnet nuget audit; 0 known vulnerabilities found. No dependency changes required. Build and tests (49/49) pass. Reports saved under 006-security-cve-remediation/.

tasks.description: Deploy the modernized PhotoAlbum application to the existing Azure Container Apps infrastructure defined in the repository.
tasks.reason: Completes the migration by deploying the updated application using the infrastructure and container definition already present in the repo.
tasks.requirements: Deploy using the existing `infra/main.bicep`, `azure.yaml`, and `Dockerfile` already defined in the repository. Do not provision new infrastructure; reuse existing resources and container app environment.
tasks.resourceStatus: Existing infrastructure already defined in repository (infra/main.bicep, azure.yaml, Dockerfile)
